items.title: 1.9 Ghar ke network ka setup aur configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 1.9 (PDF 16-17), paragraph for paragraph; our home-network figure, a comparison table from the text, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Ghar ka network ghar ke mukhtalif devices ko jorne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh computers, mobile phones aur printers ko aapas mein baat karne mein madad deta hai. Sab devices ek hi Internet connection share kar sakte hain. Router ghar ke network ka sab se ahem device hai. Network set up karne se data share karna aasan aur tez ho jata hai. Sahi configuration (settings) network ki raftar aur hifazat behtar karti hai.

blocks.alt: ISP ka badal modem se, modem router se jura hai; router se Ethernet cable wired computer tak jati hai, aur laptop aur phone Wi-Fi se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Ghar ka network: ISP, modem, router, wired aur Wi-Fi devices (asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Ghar ke network ke kai ahem hisse hote hain. Router network ke tamam devices ko jorta hai. Modem ghar ke network ko Internet Service Provider (ISP) se jorta hai. Computers, laptops aur mobile phones network devices hain. Wired connections ke liye network cables istemal hoti hain. Wireless devices Wi-Fi signals se jurte hain.

Wired network devices ko jorne ke liye cables istemal karta hai. Wired networks mein aam taur par Ethernet cables istemal hoti hain. Devices seedhe router ya switch se jure hote hain. Wired connections tez raftar aur stable (mustehkam) performance dete hain. Yeh networks wireless networks se zyada mehfooz hain. Lekin cables ki wajah se devices aazadi se idhar udhar nahi ja sakte.

Wireless network cables ke baghair devices ko jorta hai. Yeh data bhejne aur lene ke liye radio signals istemal karta hai. Gharon mein Wi-Fi sab se aam wireless technology hai. Network ki range (pohanch) ke andar devices aazadi se ghoom sakte hain. Wireless networks lagana aur chalana aasan hai. Kuch suraton mein yeh wired networks se aahista ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Wired connection ka aik faida aur wireless connection ka aik faida batayein.
blocks.explanation: Wired: zyada raftar, zyada mustehkam aur zyada mehfooz. Wireless: cables nahi, is liye devices range mein azadi se hil sakte, aur lagana asan.

items: Ghar ka network: router (markaz), modem (ISP tak), devices, cables ya Wi-Fi.
Wired: tez, stable, zyada mehfooz, magar devices aazad nahi.
Wireless: radio signals, aazad harkat, lagana aasan, kabhi aahista.
